task_intent: Open-planning scientific-answer test: determine the barnase-barstar binding-effect direction of barstar D39A relative to the wild-type complex. The agent selects structural sources, aqueous conditions, sampling, replicas, and observables. A successful answer must be supported by the submitted MD evidence and match held-out experimental truth; prior knowledge is reported separately and cannot replace MD grounding.
